snippet.title: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Begin your voyage in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined - available now!

Set out on a grand adventure with a cast of charming companions reimagined in a new doll‑like style, and rediscover an epic journey across time and lands.

Available on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam,  Microsoft Store on Windows.

Try the free demo and carry over your save data into the full game! 

All footage shown is from a game still in development.

Follow us to stay up to date with the latest DRAGON QUEST news:
Website: https://dragonquest.square-enix-games.com/games/en-us/dragon-quest-vii-reimagined/
X: https://x.com/dragonquest
